title: The Cat Question, cut to The Dip's heartbeat
technique: Borrows every camera move and cut of The Dip from a grey, blurred copy of it.
story: A shopper nearly buys a Fig & Cedar candle from Ember & Fig, late at night.
She checks the wax details. Nothing says it is safe for her cat, so she gives up.
Next morning the owner sees only three sold and decides nobody wants it.
She blows the candle out to discontinue it. Scout stops her: don't guess, your shoppers know why.
Scout goes to ask the shopper, and the owner relights the jar with a hopeful smile.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
